items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Well, they were all great, all three of them. His daddy was the clarinet and his uncle was the clarinet player, see? And he was the youngest. ... he took a B clarinet and he played everything

ctx.x: Louis was the one they called Pa Pa?
No, Pa Pa, yes, that's right. Louis was Pa Pa. Yeah. And he was the oldest boy. Yeah, that's right. Lorenzo is this boy's daddy. He's Lorenzo Junior, see? Mm-hmm.
You want to see his picture? Yes, I'd like to. Not the old man, but I mean the boy.
